source: Official Fe2OCl6 similarity-transformed DMRG workflow, especially runs/stdmrg-6/hife.py
assessment: The real workflow requires the customized CAS-excluded triples correction and a large mean-field/CC preprocessing stage. No bounded independently validated five-family pilot was established. Small replacements collapse to the existing SimilarityTransform.make_sz plus non-Hermitian dmrg calls; large unreconstructed variants would test installation or computational expense rather than demonstrated frontier capability. It was rejected before constructing a knowingly weak or unvalidated pilot.
